description: Cross-platform hole-view input overhaul in hole_viewer.gd + project.godot input settings + on-screen control affordances in main_ui.tscn. Native camera control (zoom/pan/rotate+pitch/aim) on desktop mouse+keyboard, laptop trackpad, and phone touch, keeping existing mouse behavior and the aim-never-stolen-by-pan guarantee, and preserving the retired putting_system branches (guarded). Depends on FEAT-001 (the HoleViewer band the HoleControls cluster is anchored into). Highest-risk feature; land last.
steps: Read context.json and this FEAT file first. In project.godot add a new [input_devices] section with pointing/emulate_mouse_from_touch=false (leave emulate_touch_from_mouse at default). Under [input] add new actions in the same dict format as the existing left/right/up: cam_pan->Space, cam_rotate_left->Q, cam_rotate_right->E, cam_zoom_in->'='/'+', cam_zoom_out->'-'; and bind the currently-empty 'down' action to S (physical keycode). Touch nothing else in project.godot — the 2 font-uid errors stay the accepted baseline.

In scripts/hole_viewer.gd add const DEFAULT_PITCH: float = 55.0 (matches the camera_angle/target_pitch initializers) and modify reset_view() (line ~693) to also set camera_angle = DEFAULT_PITCH and target_pitch = DEFAULT_PITCH, keeping target_yaw=0.0, is_tracking_ball=true, and the re-center on ball/hole. Add input tuning consts TAP_MOVE_THRESHOLD=10.0 (px) and TAP_TIME_THRESHOLD=350 (ms).

In scripts/hole_viewer.gd implement the shared tap-vs-drag discriminator used by both left-mouse and single-finger touch: on press/touch-down record press_pos, press_time=Time.get_ticks_msec(), set pending_tap=true and do NOT aim yet; on move past TAP_MOVE_THRESHOLD clear pending_tap and begin a single-pointer pan drag; on release/touch-up, if pending_tap still true AND (now - press_time) <= TAP_TIME_THRESHOLD, treat as a tap and aim via the existing _handle_tile_click(release_pos) -> hex_grid.set_aim_cell path, else no-op. This also fixes desktop: left-click aims only on a tap release, so pan never steals aim.

In scripts/hole_viewer.gd._input(event) keep all existing mouse handling (wheel zoom, middle-drag pitch+yaw clamped to MIN_PITCH/MAX_PITCH, right-drag pan, left tap-aim via the discriminator) and the _is_mouse_inside()/_is_mouse_over_ui_control() gating. Add handling for: InputEventScreenTouch (maintain touches: Dictionary[index->position]; set last_input_was_touch=true; drive the discriminator and multi-touch bookkeeping), InputEventScreenDrag (one finger -> pan; two fingers -> pinch+twist per the next step; set last_input_was_touch=true), InputEventMagnifyGesture (trackpad/touch pinch -> zoom via factor), InputEventPanGesture (trackpad two-finger scroll -> pan via delta; no modifier branch).

In scripts/hole_viewer.gd implement two-finger pinch+twist as independent axes each two-finger frame from the two touch positions p0,p1: pinch dist=p0.distance_to(p1), factor=dist/prev_dist guarded prev_dist>0.001, target_zoom=clamp(target_zoom/factor, min_zoom, max_zoom); twist ang=atan2(p1.y-p0.y,p1.x-p0.x), d_ang=wrapf(ang-prev_ang,-PI,PI), target_yaw+=d_ang. Seed prev_dist/prev_ang on the frame the second finger lands and cancel any pending single-finger pan/tap then; on an InputEventScreenTouch with pressed==false erase that index, and when touches empties clear is_panning/is_rotating/pending_tap/prev_dist/prev_ang. Prefer InputEventMagnifyGesture.factor over the ScreenDrag-distance path when both arrive in the same frame (no double-apply).

In scripts/hole_viewer.gd add keyboard camera control via input actions in _process/_unhandled_input, gated to when the hole band has focus or the pointer is over it and not typing elsewhere: cam_rotate_left/right -> target_yaw +/- step; left/right/up/down -> pan nudge; cam_zoom_in/out -> target_zoom -/+ zoom_speed.

In scripts/hole_viewer.gd guard _update_hovered_tile() (line ~573) to skip hover updates when last_input_was_touch is true (no hover on touch). Add a code comment in _handle_tile_click documenting the touch contract: a tap is both 'hover' and 'select' collapsed; set_aim_cell shows footprint/AOE/trajectory on a valid tile even when ShotUI is absent, and an invalid tap returns false, locks nothing, and leaves the preview on the last valid aim.

In scripts/hole_viewer.gd implement touch putting (preserving the retired putting_system branches): the tap/drag discriminator runs first even in putting mode (a single-finger drag pans); only a classified tap while is_putting_mode is a putting candidate, and it SYNTHESIZES an InputEventMouseButton (button_index=MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT, emitted pressed=true then pressed=false, position=tap_pos) forwarded to putting_system.handle_input(...) guarded on putting_system != null. Keep _handle_putting_mouse_button and all existing putting branches intact — putting_system is null today so this is a safe no-op that preserves the mouse contract if un-retired.

In scenes/ui/main_ui.tscn add a HoleControls Control cluster as a child of HoleViewer's HUD layer, pinned bottom-right of the hole band (above the Tray), with MOUSE_FILTER_STOP on the buttons only. Buttons: Zoom In -> set_zoom(target_zoom - zoom_speed), Zoom Out -> set_zoom(target_zoom + zoom_speed), Rotate -> target_yaw += deg_to_rad(45) (the guaranteed trackpad/touch rotate path), Reset view -> reset_view(). No pitch affordance. Wire the buttons to hole_viewer.gd handlers; existing _is_mouse_over_ui_control() already treats BaseButtons as UI so no special-casing is needed.
Commit locally on the branch (do NOT push): message 'feat: cross-platform hole-view input - tap/drag, touch+trackpad gestures, on-screen controls'.
acceptance_criteria: project.godot parses with the new [input_devices] emulate_mouse_from_touch=false and the new [input] actions (cam_pan/cam_rotate_left/cam_rotate_right/cam_zoom_in/cam_zoom_out and down->S); no gameplay settings changed; the 2 font errors remain the baseline.
reset_view() restores yaw AND pitch to DEFAULT_PITCH=55.0 and re-centers; a headless GOLF.tscn load does not error on reset_view or the new gesture handlers.
Left-click aims only on a tap release (pan never steals aim); the HoleControls Zoom/Rotate/Reset buttons are present and wired.

Touch/gesture branches (ScreenTouch/ScreenDrag/MagnifyGesture/PanGesture, two-finger pinch+twist, touch-putting synthesized-mouse forward) compile and do not throw on a desktop headless run where they never fire.
Running the live-hand wiring test exits 0 (16/16) and the turn-loop test exits 0 (40/40).
verification: /Applications/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot --headless --path /Users/m22stewa/Documents/Godot/Golf/.worktrees/snaplayout --editor --quit  (project.godot parses; hole_viewer.gd + main_ui.tscn compile; no new errors beyond baseline)
findings: COMPLETED. All gates clean against the FEAT-001 baseline: '--editor --quit' -> only the benign fly_camera_addon project.godot WARNING, ZERO new ERROR/SCRIPT ERROR/Parse Error lines; test_live_hand_wiring 16/16 exit 0; test_turn_loop 40/40 exit 0; a ~25s headless GOLF.tscn load produced no SCRIPT ERROR / Invalid call / nonexistent-method lines (reset_view, gesture handlers, keyboard camera, and button wiring all compile and run without firing/throwing headless). PROJECT.GODOT: added [input_devices] pointing/emulate_mouse_from_touch=false (left emulate_touch_from_mouse default). Under [input]: bound the previously-empty 'down' action to S (physical_keycode=83), and added cam_pan(Space physical 32), cam_rotate_left(Q physical 81), cam_rotate_right(E physical 69), cam_zoom_in (two events: '=' keycode 61 AND '+' keycode 43), cam_zoom_out('-' keycode 45). New actions use deadzone 0.5; existing left/right/up untouched. Nothing else in project.godot changed; the 2 font-uid errors remain the accepted baseline (they did not surface in this primed worktree, matching FEAT-001). HOLE_VIEWER.GD: added const DEFAULT_PITCH=55.0; reset_view() now also sets camera_angle=DEFAULT_PITCH and target_pitch=DEFAULT_PITCH (keeps target_yaw=0, is_tracking_ball=true, re-center). Added TAP_MOVE_THRESHOLD=10.0 and TAP_TIME_THRESHOLD=350 (int ms) plus KEY_PAN_SPEED=20.0. State vars: pending_tap/press_pos/press_time (discriminator), touches Dictionary[index->Vector2], last_input_was_touch, prev_dist/prev_ang (pinch/twist). DISCRIMINATOR: _begin_pending_tap() records press and arms pending_tap WITHOUT aiming; _resolve_pending_tap() aims via _handle_tile_click only if pending_tap still set AND elapsed<=350ms AND movement<=10px (in putting mode a classified tap instead forwards to _forward_touch_putting_tap). Left-mouse now press=arm / motion-past-threshold promotes to _begin_single_pointer_pan (via pending_tap branch in _input's motion handler) / release=resolve -> pan never steals aim and desktop left-click aims only on a tap release. _input() now routes InputEventScreenTouch/ScreenDrag/MagnifyGesture/PanGesture before mouse handling; is_interacting in the button branch now also includes pending_tap. TOUCH: _handle_screen_touch maintains touches dict, sets last_input_was_touch=true; 1 finger down arms the tap, 2nd finger cancels pending pan/tap and seeds prev_dist/prev_ang; last-finger lift resolves tap; emptying touches clears is_panning/is_rotating/pending_tap/prev_dist/prev_ang. _handle_screen_drag: 1 finger -> promote-or-pan (synthesizes an InputEventMouseMotion into _handle_mouse_motion); 2 fingers -> _apply_two_finger_gesture (pinch: target_zoom=clamp(target_zoom/factor) guarded prev_dist>0.001 & factor>0.001; twist: target_yaw+=wrapf(ang-prev_ang,-PI,PI)). _handle_magnify_gesture: zoom via factor and re-seeds prev_dist from current touches so the ScreenDrag pinch path won't double-apply the same frame. _handle_pan_gesture: pans target_position along the camera-yaw ground basis by event.delta (no modifier branch). KEYBOARD: _process_keyboard_camera(delta) called from _process, gated on NOT (LineEdit/TextEdit focused) and _is_mouse_inside(): cam_rotate_left/right -> target_yaw +/- (rotation_speed*300*delta); left/right/up/down -> ground-plane pan nudge; cam_zoom_in/out -> target_zoom -/+ (zoom_speed*delta*10); sets is_tracking_ball=false when moved. HOVER: _update_hovered_tile() early-returns when last_input_was_touch (no hover on touch). _handle_tile_click carries the documented touch contract comment (tap = hover+select collapsed; set_aim_cell previews footprint/AOE/trajectory even without ShotUI; invalid tap returns false, locks nothing, leaves last valid preview). PUTTING: _forward_touch_putting_tap synthesizes LEFT press(true) then release(false) InputEventMouseButton at tap_pos and forwards to putting_system.handle_input, guarded putting_system!=null (null today -> safe no-op); _handle_putting_mouse_button and all putting branches left intact. ON-SCREEN CONTROLS: added public handlers on_zoom_in_pressed/on_zoom_out_pressed (set_zoom(target_zoom -/+ zoom_speed)), on_rotate_pressed (target_yaw+=deg_to_rad(45), is_tracking_ball=false), on_reset_view_pressed (reset_view). MAIN_UI.TSCN: added HoleControls VBoxContainer (unique_name_in_owner) as child of HoleViewer/HoleHUD, anchored bottom-right (preset 3, offsets -148/-196..-16/-16), mouse_filter=IGNORE on the container, with four Buttons (ZoomInButton/ZoomOutButton/RotateButton/ResetViewButton, each unique_name_in_owner, default STOP filter). MAIN_UI.GD: added @onready get_node_or_null %ZoomInButton/%ZoomOutButton/%RotateButton/%ResetViewButton and in _ready() connect each .pressed to the matching hole_viewer handler (guarded on hole_viewer and each button being non-null). No gameplay/turn-loop/hole-gen/scoring/card logic touched; hex_grid.gd untouched; the four hand-UI unique names still resolve (live-hand test green). Committed locally on feature/snap-layout; not pushed. NOTE for later steps: cam_pan (Space) action is defined in project.godot but hole_viewer currently drives pan via single-pointer drag / PanGesture / WASD nudge rather than a Space-hold-pan mode; wiring Space-hold-to-pan can be layered on later without touching the action definition.
